import json,math
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
results={}
for name in ("VAR","AR"):
 d=json.load(open("inputs/"+name+".json"));m=d["metrics"];tr=d["trades"]
 gross=sum((t["exit_price"]-t["entry_price"])*abs(t["qty"])*(1 if t["type"]=="long" else -1) for t in tr)
 fees=sum(t["fee"] for t in tr);fund=sum(t.get("funding",0) for t in tr);net=sum(t["PNL"] for t in tr)
 errors={"gross_fee_funding_pnl":gross-fees+fund-net,"pnl_metrics":net-m["net_profit"],
         "terminal_vs_net":m["finishing_balance"]-10000-net,"funding_vs_metric":fund-m["funding"]["cashflow"]}
 assert all(abs(x)<1e-6 for x in errors.values()),errors
 losses=-sum(t["PNL"] for t in tr if t["PNL"]<0)
 pf=sum(t["PNL"] for t in tr if t["PNL"]>0)/losses if losses else None
 start=pd.Timestamp("2020-10-15",tz="UTC");finish=pd.Timestamp("2026-01-01",tz="UTC")
 cagr=(m["finishing_balance"]/10000)**(365/((finish-start).total_seconds()/86400))-1
 results[name]={"N":len(tr),"net":net,"return_pct":net/100,"cagr_pct":cagr*100,"pf":pf,
  "dd_daily_pct":m["max_drawdown"],"fee":fees,"funding":fund,"funding_applied":m["funding"]["applied"],
  "proxy_payments":m["funding"]["mark_price_proxy_count"],"errors":errors,
  "gross":gross,"finish":m["finishing_balance"],"raw_open_counter":m["total_open_trades"],
  "long_pnl":sum(t["PNL"] for t in tr if t["type"]=="long"),"short_pnl":sum(t["PNL"] for t in tr if t["type"]=="short")}
json.dump(results,open("output/audit.json","w"),indent=2)
print(json.dumps(results))

g=json.load(open("inputs/G_AR.json"))
a=json.load(open("inputs/AR.json"))
numeric_keys=("entry_price","exit_price","qty","fee","PNL","funding")
identity_keys=("type","opened_at","closed_at")
required=("entry_price","exit_price","qty","fee","PNL","type","opened_at","closed_at")
sortkey=lambda t:(t.get("opened_at",0),t.get("closed_at",0),t.get("type",""))
ga,aa=sorted(g["trades"],key=sortkey),sorted(a["trades"],key=sortkey)
missing=sorted({k for rows in (ga,aa) for t in rows for k in required if k not in t})
same_count=len(ga)==len(aa)
identity=same_count and not missing and all(all(x.get(k)==y.get(k) for k in identity_keys) for x,y in zip(ga,aa))
max_diff=max((abs(float(x.get(k,0) or 0)-float(y.get(k,0) or 0)) for x,y in zip(ga,aa) for k in numeric_keys),default=0.) if same_count else None
results["_G_AR_PARITY"]={"prior_session_id":"c72b53d8-c986-4131-814b-788cdc0f49e2","same_trade_count":same_count,"prior_N":len(ga),"new_N":len(aa),"missing_fields":missing,"identity_fields_equal":identity,"max_numeric_row_error":max_diff,"economically_equal_at_1e_6":bool(identity and max_diff is not None and max_diff<1e-6),"note":"Trade IDs/strategy names excluded. Control replication is not new independent evidence."}
json.dump(results,open("output/audit.json","w"),indent=2)
print(json.dumps({"control_parity":results["_G_AR_PARITY"]}))
